selected_evidence.requirement: Current host metrics from all three systems are queryable on node1
selected_evidence.summary: PromQL returned identity and available-memory series for exactly node2, node3, and node4; final samples were 0.3–4.4 seconds old.

selected_evidence.requirement: Prometheus port 9090 remains local to node1
selected_evidence.summary: Prometheus is active and enabled with its sole listener at 127.0.0.1:9090; local readiness succeeds while node2 cannot connect through node1's managed IP.

selected_evidence.requirement: Each port 9100 exporter is limited to collection by node1
selected_evidence.summary: node1 successfully retrieved live metrics from every exporter, while representative non-node1 peers timed out. All exporter and firewall services are active/enabled, and each nftables drop counter recorded its denied connection.
